welcome.title: Welcome to Rutile
welcome.subtitle: A wheel under your cursor to convert, open and share your files.
welcome.shortcut: opens the wheel under the cursor, on the selected files.
welcome.shake: Shake a file while dragging it: the wheel opens, drop it on a format.
welcome.center: Click the center to switch wheels; hold on a part for its options.
welcome.tray.macos: Settings are in Rutile’s icon, in the menu bar.
welcome.tray.windows: Settings are in Rutile’s icon, near the clock (under the ^ arrow if it isn’t there).
welcome.tray.linux: Settings are in Rutile’s icon, in the system tray.
welcome.permissions: macOS will ask for a few permissions the first time: the Finder to read the selection, screen recording for captures.
